Mapping of user token balances, mutated in _tokenTransfer.
Nested mapping of approvals, mutated in _approve.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from transfer tax; decides taxRate in _transfer.
Total token supply, derived by multiplying TOTAL_SUPPLY by 10**DECIMALS.
Current transfer tax percentage applied to non-exempt transfers.
Payable address receiving collected ETH tax and swap proceeds.
Max transaction size limit, computed as _tTotal.div(50) and changeable by owner.
Uniswap V2 router interface used for swaps, liquidity and pair creation.
Address of the created Uniswap trading pair for this token.
Flag enabling automatic swap-and-send behavior inside _transfer.
Reentrancy lock flag used by lockTheSwap modifier during swaps.
Flag indicating trading has been opened via addLiquidity.
Core private transfer routine applying limits, tax and triggering swaps/ETH sends.
Private locked function swapping contract tokens for ETH through the router.
Private function forwarding ETH balance to the tax wallet via transfer.
Internal accounting routine splitting amount into transfer amount and tax.
External onlyTaxCollector function sending contract ETH balance to tax wallet.
External onlyTaxCollector function swapping full contract token balance for ETH.
External onlyOwner function adding ETH/token liquidity and opening trading.
External onlyOwner function approving router and creating the Uniswap pair.
External onlyOwner function raising _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
Public ERC20 transfer entry point delegating to _transfer.
Public ERC20 transferFrom delegating to _transfer and _approve.
Private approval setter writing _allowances.
Receive fallback accepting plain ETH transfers.
Deploys token: sets tax wallet, tax fee, router, supply, exemptions and max tx.
Caller-supplied address used for ownership, tax wallet, transfers and approvals.
Block timestamp used as swap and liquidity deadline.
External call to swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens on the router.
Outgoing ETH transfer to _taxWallet in sendETHToFee.
External payable call to router addLiquidityETH with full contract balance.
External call to factory createPair and approval of the resulting pair.
Arithmetic computing _tTotal as TOTAL_SUPPLY * 10**DECIMALS.
Arithmetic computing _maxTxAmount as _tTotal.div(50).

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from argument into _transfer.
msg.sender is passed as owner/spender into _approve.
msg.sender becomes _owner in the Ownable constructor, granting privileged control.
msg.sender becomes the payable _taxWallet collecting ETH tax.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp is passed as deadline to addLiquidityETH.
_maxTxAmount is derived from _tTotal via div(50).
_taxFee is used as the taxRate applied in _tokenTransfer.
_isExcludedFromFee decides whether taxRate is zero in _tokenTransfer.
_uniswap router is invoked by swapTokensForEth.
_uniswap router is invoked by addLiquidity.
_uniswap router and factory are used in createUniswapPair.
_pair is compared against from/to inside _transfer to detect buys/sells.
_swapEnabled gates the automatic swap branch in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount is enforced against amount in _transfer.
_balance is read (balanceOf) inside _transfer to size the swap.
_balance entries are updated by _tokenTransfer.
createUniswapPair writes the newly created pair address into _pair.
_taxWallet is the recipient of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap operation.
sendETHToFee performs the outgoing ETH transfer operation.
addLiquidity performs the external addLiquidityETH operation.
createUniswapPair performs the external createPair operation.
Multiplication result is assigned to _tTotal.
Division result is assigned to _maxTxAmount.
transfer calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce allowance.
approve calls _approve.
_transfer invokes swapTokensForEth which performs an external call before state settlement.
_transfer invokes sendETHToFee which performs an external ETH transfer.
_transfer delegates accounting to _tokenTransfer.
swapForTax calls swapTokensForEth.
collectTax calls sendETHToFee.
createUniswapPair calls _approve for router allowance.
swapTokensForEth calls _approve before swapping.
The router swap can re-enter token transfer logic during the external call.
ETH transfer to tax wallet can invoke a fallback that re-enters the token.
The external uniswap swap call is the reentry point back into transfer handling.

normalization_plan.reason: Local parameter amount only feeds the core _transfer logic and needs no standalone identity.
from parameter is a plain argument of the core _transfer function.
to parameter is a plain argument of the core _transfer function.
contractTokenBalance is a transient local computed inside _transfer.
tokenAmount is the sole argument of the core swap function.
amount is the argument forwarded to the unsafe ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
tAmount is the input amount processed by the core accounting function.
taxRate is the tax input consumed by the core accounting function.
